prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Ana, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Ana thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a neighborhood crackdown and will be slapping us with massive fines if our bins aren't off the sidewalk by 8am sharp. They’re clearly desperate to control every single move we make now."
text: Did you hear that Mr. Henderson already got a warning? The council is officially starting a massive crackdown with huge fines if our bins aren't off the sidewalk by 8am sharp.
